generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The error message for the multi-index case contains a grammatical error: `"invalid [{}] resolution in lookup mode to an index in [{}] indices"`. The phrase "to an index in [N] indices" is incorrect. Comparing with the original message that was removed in #RCM5Y (`"invalid [table] resolution in lookup mode to [N] indices"`), the intended message should be `"invalid [{}] resolution in lookup mode to [{}] indices"` (without "an index in").
There is a trailing blank line immediately before the closing brace of the method. This is a minor style inconsistency with the rest of the file.

review_comment: Note: After debugging a little, I believe we wouldn't actually bypass security, but we would "forget" about the alias and instead act as if the concrete index was requested - which the user may or may not have permissions on. But it's still better to leave this comment as-is in to emphasize that changing this check should be scary.
